Killzone 2: Unofficial PC Port (static recompilation)
Status · Features · Screenshots · Requirements · Getting it · Building · How it works · Known issues · Accessibility · Roadmap · Release criteria · What goes online · AI use · Contributing · Related project
An unofficial port of Killzone 2 (PS3, 2009) to Windows x64, built on your PC from your own copy of the game. It is a static recompilation: the game's own code, translated ahead of time to native x64. It is not an emulator and not a rewrite . How it works: docs/HOW-IT-WORKS.md .
Status: early, partly playable. The intro movie plays, the menus run with sound, and the first level loads and draws, at about 23 frames per second in one scripted run (the PS3 runs it at 30; hand play is not measured). Full dated table: docs/STATUS.md .
Your Killzone 2 disc (US, BCUS98116), dumped as a folder or as a decrypted .iso .
The 1.29 update from your copy (on a PS3 or in RPCS3: the dev_hdd0/game/BCUS98116 folder).
The decrypted 1.29 EBOOT ( EBOOT.elf ), made from that update's EBOOT.BIN .
No emulator runs while you play. If you play the game in the PS3 emulator RPCS3, the setup can find all three in your RPCS3 install ("Use my RPCS3 install"). What each must contain: docs/GETTING-FILES.md . This project ships none of them and gives no decryption steps.
Download the Windows installer (recommended) or the portable zip from v0.1.6 on the releases page (every release is a pre-release for now).
Run it and point it at your disc dump, the 1.29 update and the decrypted EBOOT.
It translates and builds the game's code on your machine; no game code, assets or keys are shipped or downloaded.
Do not install into a OneDrive folder. More: docs/INSTALL.md , docs/GETTING-FILES.md , docs/requirements.md . Changes per version: CHANGELOG.md .
The sky draws green in the first level (cause not yet known).
Speed is below the PS3's in scripted runs; hand play is not measured.
Not yet confirmed on native Windows by us (players report playing there).
Keyboard and mouse: only checked in scripted runs, not by hand; pads work.
Project Helghast : Killzone 3 (PS3) ported to PC the same way. Project Pyrrhus uses its method and reuses its general runtime work (ps3recomp fixes, renderer, SPU job system), adapted to Killzone 2. Most patches in port/patches/ come from there; the rest are Killzone 2's own. Its builds are pre-releases on its releases page , as this project's are.
This port currently supports Direct3D 12 only. For a Vulkan version of a Killzone 2 port, please use Tokisaki Port , which is developed separately by its own author.
Project Pyrrhus is made by undecuple : GitHub @undecuple , Reddit u/RelationshipNo4440 , Discord itekso. (on the ps3recomp server). Builds and fixes come only from this repository's GitHub Releases ; we never ask anyone to paste a command into PowerShell or a terminal. Anyone else offering builds, "fixes" or donations in this project's name is not us.
Pull requests are welcome: .github/CONTRIBUTING.md .
This project is developed by one person with AI coding agents, with the maintainer reviewing and merging their work: docs/AI.md .
The port's own code, tools and documentation: MIT . Third-party components and credits: NOTICE.md . The licence covers nothing of the game itself. Security problems: SECURITY.md . Reuse, including by AI systems and automated tools: NOTICE.md .
Pyrrhus is the Helghast capital where most of Killzone 2 is fought; Project Pyrrhus is a fan project, not official and not affiliated with or endorsed by Sony Interactive Entertainment or Guerrilla Games.
You need your own copy of the game. This repository contains only the port: source code, patches to the recompiler, tools and documentation. It contains no game code, data, assets, keys or firmware, and it never will. Killzone 2 is © Sony Interactive Entertainment.
Killzone 2 // Unofficial PC Port (static recompilation). Work in progress, partly playable. Builds on your PC from your own game.
